## 119 Mountains with Prominence of 600 Meters or Greater -- the "Majors"

List provided by and maintained by Alan Dawson  
 2004 Update by Rob Woodall & Jonathan de Ferranti  
 2006 addition of sub-Majors by Mark Trengove

By request, we have prepared a consolidated list for the British Isles to Prominence=600 meters. This list is a companion to a [NEW MAP OF THE SUMMITS](http://www.peaklist.org/WWmaps/euro/GB_Ire.gif) that identifies all of the P610m summits and also locates all of the British and Irish Marilyns.

Please note: Previously available lists used a cutoff of 2,000 feet (609.6 meters).  The 2000 foot cutoff would result in a total of 111 mountains -- 90 for Great Britain, 1 for Isle of Man, and 20 for Ireland. By lowering the cutoff to 600 meters (in order to be consistent with upcoming lists for Europe), we now reach a total of 119 mountains, including 93 for Great Britain, 1 on Man, and 25 in Ireland.  
  
 Mark Trengove has added the seven sub-Majors, or peaks whose estimated prominence falls between 590m and 600m. By including these mountains, we are likely to catch any additional summits that could in fact achieve 600m, but fall short either to contour uncertainty, rounding error, or map error. Mark also keeps a register of those who have completed this list, both Majors and Sub-Majors.
